title: fix(app-shell): a single-record list header action is disabled with its reason unless exactly one row is selected
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

Fixes #27831
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：列表页头上的「单条记录」动作（如 Tasks → Reassign…），没选行或选了多行时画成禁用，悬停提示就是点击后原本才会弹出的那句拒绝理由（按会话语言）；恰好选一行才可点；行根本不能勾选的列表上不再画这个按钮。
- 为什么改：以前没选行时按钮看起来可用，点了才说「请先选择一行」；成员看到的表格没有勾选框，这个按钮对他永远是死路。
- 风险与回滚：页头只是向动作执行器问「现在点会不会被拒」，规则还是原来那一条，点击时的拒绝仍作兜底；回滚即还原本 PR。ObjectGrid 里一段计算选择模式的代码整体上移到提前返回之前（逻辑未改）。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewHeaderLaunchGate.tsx`（页头门控）、`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`（新增 `launchRefusal` / `subscribeContext`）、`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`（发布 `selectionAvailable` 的 effect 与上移的那段）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.headerSelectionGate-27831.test.tsx`，预期 7 个用例全绿（0 行禁用并带理由、1 行可点并发出请求、2 行禁用、中文理由、不可勾选的列表不画、两个对照不受影响）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

On a list, a header action that runs on a single record is now drawn the way a launch of it would end:

- **0 rows, or more than one row:** disabled. Its tooltip and accessible description are the early refusal a click already gave ("This action runs on a single record — select a row first." / "… select exactly one row."), in the session's language, from the existing `actions.selectRowFirst` / `actions.selectExactlyOneRow` keys. No new i18n key.
- **Exactly one row:** enabled, and it runs as before.
- **A list whose rows cannot be selected:** not drawn.
- **The early refusal stays as the backstop** for any launch that still reaches `execute` (a `?runAction=` deep link, a surface that does not draw through the gate).

**How the header knows an action is record-scoped, with no second rule.** The header asks the action runner, never `isRecordScopedAction` directly. `ActionRunner.launchRefusal(action)` (new, public) is exactly the refusal `execute` asks before the confirmation and the param dialog: it resolves the dispatch type the way `execute` does (`resolveDispatchType`), asks that handler's `refuseBeforeInput`, and translates the answer by its `errorKey`. For the console's `script` and `flow` handlers that is `@object-ui/core`'s `resolveServerActionRecordId`, which reads `isRecordScopedAction` and the selection. Asking runs, sends and shows nothing. A core test holds `launchRefusal` equal to what `execute` refuses for the same context.

**Where the selection count lives.** `ObjectGrid` already publishes its checkbox selection into the runner context (`selectedRecords`, through `useAction().updateContext`). It now also publishes `selectionAvailable` (whether its rows can be selected at all, i.e. its resolved selection mode is not off), and clears it on unmount. To publish while the grid is still loading, the existing selection-mode computation (bulk-action resolution included) moved, unchanged, above the grid's early returns; it is hook-free and reads only values declared before its new position. `ActionRunner.subscribeContext(listener)` (new, public) lets the header redraw when the grid publishes. The header reads two stable snapshots through `useSyncExternalStore` (the grid's selection array and the boolean), so an unrelated context write redraws nothing.

**Where it is drawn.** `ListHeaderActionBar` (`objectViewHeaderLaunchGate.tsx`) wraps the three `action:bar` render points of the `ObjectView` header: the toolbar in `ObjectViewPageHeader`, and the primary toolbar action and folded menu in `useObjectViewHeaderChrome`. It sets the `disabled: true` / `disabledReason` pair the `action:*` renderers already draw (tooltip trigger and `aria-describedby` from `objectui#11839`), so no renderer changed. A host callback (`onClick`, such as Import in the folded menu) never reaches the runner and is never gated.

Files:

- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`: `launchRefusal`, `subscribeContext`, and the notification in `updateContext`.
- `ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`: `ActionContext.selectionAvailable?: boolean`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: publishes `selectionAvailable`; the selection-mode block moved above the early returns.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewHeaderLaunchGate.tsx` (new), `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`, `objectViewHeaderChrome.tsx`: the gate and its three render points.
- Tests: `ObjectView.headerSelectionGate-27831.test.tsx` (new), `ActionRunner.launchRefusal-27831.test.ts` (new), `ObjectView.toolbarScriptSelection-12331.test.tsx` (updated pin).
- `.changeset/27831-list-header-selection-gate.md` (patch).

`Clause-②: yes (widening)`: two new public members on `ActionRunner` and one optional `ActionContext` member, all additive. The claim said `no`; the order allows the widening arm when an export is needed, and these are needed, because the header cannot reach the runner's private refusal or learn of a context change otherwise.

## Tests

The measured repro on `main` (`fec60e00`) comes first. The new ObjectView suite was run against the base sources (the five non-test files restored from `fec60e00`, then put back from `HEAD`; `git diff HEAD` was empty afterwards). It showed **4 failed | 3 passed (7)**. On main, 0 rows: `expect(element).toBeDisabled()` got "Received element is not disabled". 2 rows and zh: the same. No-selection list: "expected button … to be null". 1 row and both controls passed on main.

New and changed pins, through the real `ObjectView`, grid, `action:bar`/`action:button` and console action runtime:

- 0 rows: disabled, with the zero-row refusal as its description. A click sends nothing.
- 1 row: enabled, and a click POSTs the row's `recordId`.
- 2 rows: disabled, with the "exactly one row" refusal.
- zh session: the reason is the zh pack's `actions.selectRowFirst`.
- No-selection grid (`selection: { type: 'none' }`): the record-scoped action is not drawn.
- Control: an object-level `list_toolbar` action is enabled with 0 rows and dispatches. It is also drawn on the no-selection list.
- Core: `launchRefusal` for 0, 1 and 2 rows and for no published selection. It equals what `execute` refuses, follows `updateContext`, and is translated by key. A typeless declaration routes to the spec default handler. Controls: an object-level action, and a handler with no early refusal. `subscribeContext` notifies, and stops after unsubscribe.
- `ObjectView.toolbarScriptSelection-12331`: its 0- and 2-row cases now read the refusal off the disabled header button instead of a toast after a click. No dialog opens and no request is sent, as before.

Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the gate's `runner.launchRefusal(…)` call was replaced by `undefined`. The anchor went 1 → 0, and the blob went `3c7bbfc1872a` → `51a18c64a2c5`. The suite went **4 failed | 3 passed**: the same four cases as on main. The file was restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. app-shell tests resolve `@object-ui/*` to `src` through the `ui/vitest.config.mts` aliases, so no `dist` was involved.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/ packages/plugin-grid/`: 307 files, 2967 tests passed.
- 127 targeted files: every app-shell test naming `list_toolbar`, the header chrome, `selectedRecords` or `selectionAvailable`; every `ObjectView*` test; the `action:*` renderer tests; and react, components and plugin-list tests naming `selectedRecords` / `updateContext`. 127 files, 1440 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/{types,core,plugin-grid,app-shell} type-check`: all exit 0.
- After merging `origin/main`, the rerun on the final head is listed under Verification.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Object-level actions with several rows.** An action declared at `list_toolbar` alone is drawn disabled when several rows are selected, with the "select exactly one row" reason, because a click is refused the same way today: the resolver refuses any non-aggregate launch with more than one row. This follows the resolver and adds no rule. With 0 rows such an action is unaffected.
- **Phone card view.** On a phone, the grid's card list draws no checkboxes, but the grid's selection mode is still on, so a record-scoped header action is drawn disabled with its reason (in the overflow menu) rather than left out. This is accurate but not ideal. It is noted, not changed.
- **Non-grid views** (kanban, calendar …) publish no selection into the runner, so a record-scoped header action there is drawn disabled with the zero-row reason. A click is refused the same way today.
- **Deep link.** A `?runAction=` naming a record-scoped action on a no-selection list is not drawn, so it does not run. The arming in `useOfferedNavRunAction` reads the ungated list, so by reading that hook (not measured) the link is still consumed. On a selectable list a disabled action still auto-triggers once and is refused by the backstop, as `ObjectView.bulkWiredHeaderDuplicate-12462` pins.
- `EnvironmentListToolbar` (`sys_environment`) draws its own bar from `headerToolbarActions` and is not routed through the gate.
- Static `properties.params` on a header action are not part of what the gate asks. The resolver reads `params.recordId` only from the forwarded values, and a `list_toolbar` action authoring a static `recordId` is not a shape found in the tree.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` #2 (docs-driven): no docs page describes `ActionRunner`'s context members or the early refusal, so none was updated.

## Verification

Final head `d78f7954` (`origin/main` merged once, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and the app-shell build closure rebuilt):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 35 derived families, each run on this head, all `exit 0`. `--ran` reconciliation: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is among them.
- `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- Targeted rerun: the three `ObjectView` header suites (27831, 12331, 12462), the core `launchRefusal-27831` and `recordRowGuard-13384` suites, the console `flowRowGuard-13397` suite and every `action:*` renderer suite. 43 files, 665 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0.
- Not run locally, left to CI: the full `Test UI` shards, `Lint UI` and the repo lint. ESLint on the changed files reports one error, at a line `ObjectGrid` had before this change (`react-hooks/static-components` under `--no-inline-config`; the base blob reports the same error). The new files report none.
